changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup') BEGIN DROP TABLE [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup]( [RuleID] [int] NOT NULL, [ResponsibilityTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [SecurityAsset] [char](1) NOT NULL, [SecurityAssetID] [int] NOT NULL, [Context] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [ApplyToType] [bit] NOT NULL, [PermissionsBitMask] [int] NULL, [IsVisible] [bit] NULL, [Overridden] [bit] NOT NULL, [OverrideID] [bigint] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [RuleID] ASC, [ResponsibilityTypeID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC, [AssetTypeID] ASC, [SecurityAsset] ASC, [SecurityAssetID] ASC, [ApplyToType] ASC, [Overridden] ASC, [OverrideID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem_OverrideID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem_OverrideID_Include] ON [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] ( [OverrideID] ASC ) INCLUDE([RuleID],[Overridden]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult] ON [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] ( [AssetID] ASC, [Overridden] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_Asset_PermissionsBitMask_SecurityAsset') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_Asset_PermissionsBitMask_SecurityAsset] ON [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] ( [AssetID] ASC, [PermissionsBitMask] ASC, [SecurityAsset] ASC, [SecurityAssetID] ASC ) END IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_Overridden_ResponsibilityTypeID_IsVisible_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_Overridden_ResponsibilityTypeID_IsVisible_Include] ON [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] ( [Overridden] ASC, [ResponsibilityTypeID] ASC, [IsVisible] ASC ) INCLUDE([AssetID],[AssetTypeID],[PermissionsBitMask],[SecurityAsset],[SecurityAssetID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_ResponsibilityType_AssetType') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_ResponsibilityType_AssetType] ON [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] ( [ResponsibilityTypeID] ASC, [AssetTypeID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_Rule') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_Rule] ON [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] ( [RuleID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_SecurityAssetSecurityAssetIDOverridenInclude') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationRuleResult_SecurityAssetSecurityAssetIDOverridenInclude] ON [dbo].[responsibilitytyperelationruleresult_backup] ( [SecurityAsset] ASC, [SecurityAssetID] ASC, [Overridden] ASC ) INCLUDE([RuleID],[ResponsibilityTypeID],[AssetID],[AssetTypeID],[Context],[ApplyToType],[PermissionsBitMask],[IsVisible],[OverrideID]) END
